materialRampModal.title: Generate material ramp
materialRampModal.environmentReadError: Couldn't read that file as a PNG image.

tooltips.targetBaseColor: The desired final rendered appearance — the Albedo color below is solved to match it.
tooltips.albedoColor: The raw material input the ramp is actually generated from — solved automatically from the Target base color above. Rarely needed directly.
tooltips.presets: Quickly set Metallic and Roughness to common material presets. Your base color is unchanged.
tooltips.metallic: How metallic the surface is. 0 = dielectric (plastic, cloth, stone); 1 = pure metal (steel, gold, copper).
tooltips.roughness: How rough the surface is. Low values give a small, sharp, bright highlight; high values spread it into a soft, dim sheen.
tooltips.rampColors: How many colors to compress the material's full light response into. More colors preserve finer value changes; fewer colors force a tighter, more stylized ramp.
tooltips.ambientColor: A flat fill light hitting the material from every direction equally, independent of surface orientation — keeps the darkest end of the ramp from going to pure black, including for pure metals via an approximate Fresnel specular term.
tooltips.ambientIntensity: How bright the ambient fill light is.
tooltips.environment: A real reflection image sampled by the material's mirror direction and roughness — richer than the flat ambient fill above, especially for polished or metallic materials.
tooltips.environmentIntensity: How strongly the environment reflection contributes, on top of the ambient fill above.
tooltips.lightColor: The color of the direct light illuminating the material.
tooltips.lightIntensity: How bright the direct light is.
tooltips.lightDirection: Direction the light shines from, as a normalized (x, y, z) vector. Fixed for now — will be editable in a future version. Together with the view direction, this also defines the plane surface orientation is swept through to generate the ramp.
tooltips.viewDirection: Direction the camera is looking from, as a normalized (x, y, z) vector. Fixed for now — will be editable in a future version. Pairs with the light direction to define the plane surface orientation is swept through.

warnings.albedoNearWhite: The albedo color is very close to white, leaving little room to show highlights — bright stops in the ramp may look nearly identical. Try a less extreme Target base color.
warnings.albedoNearBlack: The albedo color is very close to black, leaving little room to show shadows — dark stops in the ramp may look nearly identical. Try a less extreme Target base color.
warnings.achievableExactly: This target base color is achievable exactly — {{target}}.
warnings.unreachable: This target base color isn't achievable with the current metallic, roughness, and lighting settings — target {{target}}, closest achievable {{achieved}}.
warnings.imprecise: The exact target base color couldn't be matched precisely — target {{target}}, closest achievable {{achieved}}.
